classes.prof: A Warrior is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, one exotic weapon, and all armor.
A Specialist is proficient with simple and martial weapons and with light and medium armor.
A Consular is proficient with simple weapons and lightsabers.

generic.text: Choose one skill. You gain a bonus on checks with that skill equal to 1/2 your level (minimum +1). All Knowledge skills count as a single skill for this class feature. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different skill.

Choose one skill. You can always take 10 with that skill, even when stress or distractions would normally prevent it. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different skill.
Choose up to four skills. They become class skills for you. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose different skills.
You gain one feat of your choice. You must meet its prerequisites. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different feat.

You gain one of the following feats: Athletic, Brew Potion, Catch Off-Guard, Combat Expertise, Dazzling Display, Deceitful, Defensive Combat Training, Endurance, Ghost Whisperer, Improved Counterspell, Inscribe Magical Tattoo, Intimidating Prowess, Lucid Dreamer, Persuasive, Pesh Adept, Psychic Sensitivity, Scribe Scroll, Sea Legs, Siege Engineer, Stealthy, Vermin Heart. You must meet its prerequisites. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different feat.

Choose one of the following: fear and emotion effects; charm and compulsion effects; confusion and insanity effects; death effects, negative energy and energy drain; poison and disease; curses and hexes; traps; one school of magic; or one creature type. You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against it. This bonus increases to +4 at 10th level. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different option.

Choose one of the following: disease, fear, poison, sleep effects, negative energy and energy drain, or one of the blinded, confused, dazzled, deafened, fatigued or sickened conditions. You become immune to it. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different option.

Choose one of detect magic, detect poison, detect undead, one detect alignment spell, or a detection of one creature type that works the same way. You can use it at will as a spell-like ability. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different spell.

Choose one spell of a level no higher than 1/2 your level, rounded down (minimum 1st, maximum 6th). You can cast it once per day as a spell-like ability, using your level as your caster level. Once chosen, the spell cannot be changed. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different spell.
You can move through nonmagical difficult terrain and undergrowth at your normal speed and without taking damage or suffering any other impairment.

Choose climb or swim. You gain that movement speed, equal to 1/2 your base speed. At 10th level, it increases to your base speed. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose the other movement.
Choose one martial or exotic weapon. You become proficient with it. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different weapon.

Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic. You gain resistance 5 to that energy type. This increases to resistance 10 at 10th level. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different energy type.
Choose low-light vision, darkvision 60 feet, or scent. You gain that ability. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different ability.
You can hold your breath for a number of minutes equal to your Constitution score. At 6th level, you can breathe water as easily as air.

Choose animals, plants, one creature type, or all languages. You can speak with that kind of creature at will. If you choose all languages, you can cast tongues on yourself three times per day as a spell-like ability instead. You can take this class feature more than once. Each time, choose a different option.
You gain 2 additional skill ranks at each level.
Once per day, you can reroll one d20 you just rolled, before the result is revealed. You must take the second result.
Choose one bite or gore attack (1d6) or two claw attacks (1d4). You gain those primary natural attacks.
You gain a fly speed equal to your base speed with average maneuverability. You can dismiss or manifest your means of flight as a free action.
You gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks. This bonus increases to +4 at 10th level.

weapons.sp: Double. Undefensive. Two-Weapon Monster. Intimidating. Sunderable.
Armor Pen 1. Automatic. Recoil 2. Light Weapon.

forms.text: As a standard action (1 AP), you can make a single lightsaber attack at your full base attack bonus against a foe within reach. If you hit, you deal damage normally and can make an additional attack (using your full base attack bonus) against up to two other foes that are also within reach. You take a –2 penalty to your Armor Class until the start of your next turn for each additional attack you make with this feat.
You can now attack up to 3 foes and make a 5-foot move in between if you have not used it, and the penalty drops to –1 AC for each attack instead of –2.
You can apply the benefits of Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, and Greater Vital Strike to all attacks made using Shii-cho Style.
You can make a Bluff check to feint in combat as a move action (1 AP). Counts as having Improved Feint. You also gain +1 to attack and AC with/against lightsabers whenever you are in a 1-on-1 fight.

You can feint as a swift action (1 AP), or feint as a move action (1 AP) and gain +2 to your next attack. The +1 to attack and AC rises to +2, and now half of it still applies if you are not in a 1-on-1 fight.

You can feint as a free action, but you take a –10 penalty on the Bluff check. If you feint as a swift action (1 AP) you gain +2 to attack and damage on the first hit; if you feint as a move action (1 AP) you gain +2 critical threat range (+1, not multiplicable, if you have Improved Critical). The bonus to attack and AC in a 1-on-1 fight is now +3.

You take only a –2 penalty on attack rolls for fighting defensively. While using this style and fighting defensively or using the total defense action, you gain an additional +1 dodge bonus to your Armor Class.

When fighting defensively you gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against melee and blaster attacks. If a melee or blaster attack misses you by 4 or less, you lose this dodge bonus until the beginning of your next turn. If you are using the total defense action instead, you can deflect one melee or blaster attack that would normally hit you. An attack so deflected deals no damage and has no other effect (instead treat it as a miss).

You take only a –1 penalty on attack rolls for fighting defensively. Whenever you deflect an opponent’s attack using soresu experto or lose the dodge bonus from soresu experto because an attack missed you by 4 or less, you can make an attack of opportunity against the attacker after the attack misses. If your attack succeeds, you don't lose the dodge bonus and can do it again.

You gain a +2 bonus on acrobatics checks. While using the ataru Style feat, when an opponent targets you with a melee or ranged attack, you can spend an immediate action (1 AP of your next turn) to make an acrobatics check. You can use the result as your AC or touch AC against that attack. You must be aware of the attack and not flat-footed.

Each time you hit with an unarmed or lightsaber strike while using ataru Style, you can move 5 feet without provoking an attack of opportunity as long as you move to a space adjacent to the opponent you hit with the attack. If you use this feat, you cannot take a 5-foot step during your next turn. You can now also use your Acrobatics result twice in place of your AC with a single immediate action (1 AP of your next turn) (that is, to dodge 2 things in the same round).

You gain Pounce, and you can charge through difficult terrain (unless it is difficult terrain that also affects the air) and charge through obstacles as long as you can jump over them (that is, you cannot go through a wall, but you can jump over one).

Benefits: While using this style, when an opponent makes an attack of opportunity against you for moving through a threatened square, you can spend a swift action (1 AP) to make a retaliatory unarmed strike attack against that opponent. Your attack is resolved after the triggering attack of opportunity. Also, if someone shoots at you and you successfully defend against it, you can spend an immediate action (1 AP of your next turn) to send the bolt back.

While using shien Style, you can spend a free action, instead of spending a immediate action (1 AP of your next turn), to make a retaliatory lightsaber strike or to return a bolt. You can make a number of retaliatory lightsaber strikes and bolt returns on your turn equal to your Wisdom modifier.

While using Shien Style, your retaliatory lightsaber strikes are resolved before the triggering attacks. If your retaliatory lightsaber strike deals damage to an opponent, that opponent takes a –2 penalty on attack and damage rolls with the triggering attack of opportunity. You also gain +2 AC against blasters, and switching to Djem-so is a free action instead of a swift action.
While using this style, when you use the charge action, the bonus on your attack roll increases by 1 and you deal 2d6 additional points of damage with one melee attack made as part of the charge.

When you hit a target with a lightsaber strike you reduce their AC by 1 until the beginning of their turn. When you hit a target with a lightsaber strike and you have hit that target with a lightsaber strike previously that round, you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage.
Now all the attacks you make reduce AC by 2, and each extra hit deals 2d6 instead of 1d6. Switching to Shien is a free action instead of a swift action.

While using Niiman Style, you can add your Intelligence modifier to the lightsabers damage (instead of any other ability bonus or modifier you can add to your weapon damage). The weapon must be one appropriate for your size.
Benefits: You can add 1½ × your Intelligence modifier, or add your Intelligence modifier to your Strength modifier.

Reduce the two-weapon fighting penalty by 1 (only if you do not use spells), and you learn to cast force powers and wield your lightsaber at the same time. This functions much like two-weapon fighting, but the off-hand weapon is a force power that is being cast. To use this ability, the character must have one hand free (even if the spell being cast does not have somatic components), while wielding a light or one-handed lightsaber in the other hand.

While using this style, you gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against sleep effects, paralysis effects, and stunning effects. You ignore difficult terrain when you charge, run, or withdraw. You can also charge through squares that contain allies.
You can add 1-1/2 times your Strength bonus on the damage roll for your first lightsaber attack on a given round.

While using this Style, increase your Strength bonus on lightsaber strike damage rolls by an additional one-half your Strength bonus, to a total of double your Strength bonus on the first attack and 1-1/2 times your Strength bonus on the other attacks. When you score a critical hit or a successful Stunning Fist attempt against an opponent while using this style, that opponent is also shaken for a number of rounds equal to 1d4 + your Strength bonus.

powers.text: Negates falling damage, up to a maximum of 5 ft. per caster level, with a cap of 50 ft.
You move up to half your speed by jumping in any direction you choose.
You detect force auras. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you study a particular area or subject.
You detect life. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you study a particular area or subject.
+2 to 1 physical ability score of your choice, or +4 to 1 physical skill of your choice.
+10 ft. to all types of movement you have.

You make a CMB check using your casting ability and your caster level. If you succeed, you move someone 5 ft. in the direction you choose. For every 5 by which you beat the enemy's CMD, you move them 5 ft. farther, up to a maximum of 15 ft. If you move someone into a solid object, you deal 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage to them.

You point your hand at an object and can lift it and move it at will from a distance. As a move action (1 AP), you can propel the object as far as 15 feet in any direction, though the spell ends if the distance between you and the object ever exceeds the spell's range.

You move your target, either in a direction of your choice or toward yourself, 5 ft. per 2 caster levels (minimum 5 ft., or 0 if they resist), up to a maximum of 30 ft. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. For every 5 ft. that someone has to move but cannot because of a wall, the ground or anything else, they take 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage.

You move everything in the cone away from you, in the direction opposite to where the cone comes from, 5 ft. per 2 caster levels (minimum 5 ft., or 0 if they resist), up to a maximum of 15 ft. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. For every 5 ft. that someone has to move but cannot because of a wall, the ground or anything else, they take 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage.

You strike your target with the Force, dealing 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage per caster level (maximum 5d6) and pushing them back 5 ft. If they save, they negate the movement and take half damage. The movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

You make a ranged attack that hits everything in the line and deals your lightsaber's damage + your Strength or casting ability modifier to each. You can use your casting ability instead of Dexterity for the ranged attack. If you fail to beat the AC of someone wielding a lightsaber, the line ends at that creature. It can be used in a full-round action (3 AP) as one of your attacks, if you have more than one.

You hurl a small object from the surroundings, weighing no more than 1 lb., at the enemy, extremely fast and over a long distance. You make a ranged touch attack that deals 1d4+2 points of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage, depending on what you throw. You can throw one extra object for every 2 caster levels above 1, up to a maximum of 5 objects at caster level 9. You can use your casting ability instead of Dexterity for the ranged attack.
You move up to your speed by jumping in any direction you choose.
Negates falling damage, up to a maximum of 10 ft. per caster level.

You let out a terrible, wild scream, slightly empowered by the Force. It deals 1d4 points of sonic damage per caster level, maximum 5d4. Targets are deafened for 1 round unless they succeed on the save.

powers.dur: concentration (up to 1 round/level) or instantaneous; see text
powers.text: You move objects or creatures by concentrating on them. Depending on the version selected, the spell can provide a gentle, sustained force, perform a variety of combat maneuvers, or exert a single short, violent thrust.
+2 deflection bonus to AC, +1 additional per 6 caster levels.

You let out a terrible, ultra bass-boosted scream empowered by the Force. It deals 1d4 points of sonic damage per caster level, maximum 10d4. Targets are deafened for 1 round unless they succeed on the save.
